counting_rule: Only current raw outputs actually visually reviewed and satisfying the current hair, collar and fullsize art contract count. Refused, pending and rejected outputs never count. This is art coverage, not live-game or release acceptance.
remote_scope: The pinned remote receipt covers its own exact 2861 PNGs. Later local PNGs and newly applied approvals remain for the next production checkpoint; no push acknowledgement or local cache is called full remote readback.
forecast_assumptions: 30-45 net visually qualified unique sources per continuous hour, including usual repairs/refusals. Service-held/exhausted sources, remaining HIGH gate, 748 unresolved baseline references, storage reservation for a full export and live-game validation can delay completion. Estimates are not release dates.
execution: Continue the sole built-in image lane while staging manual review decisions and preparing distinct next HIGH sources; checkpoints and half-way reporting do not pause the main task.
